newsitem.title: USA: Allied Products Verson unit workers strike.
newsitem.headline: Allied Products Verson unit workers strike.

text.p: Allied Products Corp said 450 workers at a metal-forming presses plant here entered a third day of a strike Wednesday, and new talks with the union have not been scheduled.
United Auto Workers members at the company's Verson division went on strike Monday, the day after rejecting a wage offer from the company, said Allied Chief Financial Officer Kenneth Light.
Production at the division, which makes metal-bending presses for the auto industry, has remained at scheduled levels with the help of supervisory employees, he said.

Allied Products had offered a wage increase in excess of the average 3-percent increase being offered by other companies in the area to their workers, Light said. The contract also involved pension plan improvements.
While a bargaining committee of the union recommended ratification of the company's offer, workers rejected it June 22, Allied Products said.
